newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones, Individual in deal.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones, Individual in deal.

text.p: Dow Jones & Co's Dow Jones Business Information Services said on Friday it would offer DowVision, its subscription, direct-to-desktop custom news service product, over two Individual Inc applications.

The company said it would offer DowVision, which combines same-day full-text from the Wall Street Journal, The New York Times, The Washington Post, Los Angeles Times and Financial Times and other news sources, over Individual's Hoover NewsAlert and First! services.
Individual's customized information services integrate publications through personalized views on intranet and Lotus Notes enterprise platforms, it said.
Individual said it planned to integrate these two services for intranet and platforms in the second quarter of 1997.
